workspace.title: Workspace

empty.title: No simulation scripts here yet
empty.body: Studio lists every <cmd>.py</cmd> file in this folder and its subfolders. Add a simulation script here, or choose another folder in Settings.

workspace.noGpu: No CUDA device found; runs use the CPU backend.
workspace.truncated: This folder holds more than {{limit}} scripts, so only the first {{limit}} are listed. Choose a smaller folder in Settings.
workspace.staleHint: The script changed after this run.
workspace.missing: The workspace folder no longer exists.

new.title: New simulation from a template
new.name: File name
new.exists: A script with this name already exists here.
new.bad_name: Use letters, digits, - and _ only, at most 64.
new.failed: The script could not be created.

reason.unreadable: The run status file cannot be read.
reason.invalid_json: The run status file is not valid JSON.
reason.invalid_fields: The run status file has unexpected contents.
reason.interrupted: The run stopped reporting before it finished: its process ended unexpectedly.

backend.label: Backend
backend.help: Where simulations run. Auto uses the first CUDA device, or the CPU when there is none.
backend.noDevice: No CUDA device found; runs use the CPU backend.
backend.cupyMissing: CuPy is not installed, so runs use the CPU. Install <cmd>etalon[gpu]</cmd> to use an NVIDIA GPU.
backend.cupyError: CuPy could not query the GPU, so runs use the CPU.

workspace.label: Workspace folder
workspace.help: Studio lists the simulation scripts in this folder. <cmd>etalon studio FOLDER</cmd> sets it at launch; a change here lasts until Studio stops.

errors.workspace_not_a_directory: This is a file, not a folder.
errors.workspace_not_absolute: Enter the full path of the folder.

units.label: Length units
units.help: How lengths are shown. Scripts always use micrometres.

snapshots.label: Live field snapshots
snapshots.help: Show a low-resolution field while a simulation runs. Costs a little speed.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.body: Studio makes no network requests. Fonts and assets are bundled. Nothing leaves this machine.

simulation.notFound: No simulation with this id in the workspace.
simulation.notFoundHint: The script may have been moved, renamed or deleted.

notYet.title: Not in this version yet
notYet.setup: Setup (structure tree, 3D preview, cost estimate) is not in this version yet.
notYet.run: Run monitoring (progress, energy decay, live field, log) is not in this version yet.
notYet.results: The results viewer (S-parameters, fields, modes, export) is not in this version yet.
notYet.modes: The Mode Solver page is not in this version yet.
notYet.validation: The validation report page is not in this version yet.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is no Studio page at this address.

errors.network: Cannot reach the Studio server. Is <cmd>etalon studio</cmd> still running?
errors.server: The Studio server answered with an error ({{status}}).

session.title: This Studio session has ended
session.body: Run <cmd>etalon studio</cmd> again and open the link it prints.

vacuum_pulse.title: Vacuum pulse
vacuum_pulse.description: A Gaussian pulse from a point source spreads through vacuum into a quiet CPML.

strip_waveguide.title: Strip waveguide (2D)
strip_waveguide.description: A silicon strip in oxide, driven by a point source near the start of the strip.

sharp_bend.title: Sharp 90° bend (2D)
sharp_bend.description: Two silicon strips meet at a right angle: see what a sharp corner radiates.

phc_waveguide.title: Photonic-crystal waveguide (2D)
phc_waveguide.description: A line defect in a square lattice of air holes in silicon: the band gap keeps the light in the line.

setup.runFailed: The run could not be started.

view.label: View
view.hint3d: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom; <cmd>1</cmd> <cmd>2</cmd> <cmd>3</cmd> for top, front and side, <cmd>F</cmd> to frame.
view.hintSlice: The solver's own permittivity on the simulated plane: exactly what will run.

inspector.label: Inspector
inspector.empty: Select an object in the tree or the view.

slice.label: Relative permittivity on the simulated plane, CPML included
slice.hint: Point at the map for the value.

estimate.label: Estimate
estimate.unknown: unknown until a run or a calibration
estimate.calibrateHint: Runs the solver for about 10 s to measure this machine's speed.

warnings.label: Warnings
warnings.mesh_coarse: Mesh: <v>{{cells}}</v> cells per wavelength in <v>{{medium}}</v> at <v>{{wavelength}}</v>; at least <v>{{minimum}}</v> are needed.
warnings.pml_thin: The CPML is <v>{{thickness}}</v> thick, less than half a wavelength (<v>{{half}}</v>): reflections may come back.
warnings.near_pml: <v>{{object}}</v> is only <v>{{cells}}</v> cells from the CPML.
warnings.unsupported_3d: 3D simulations arrive in <v>{{milestone}}</v>; this build runs 2D TE only.
warnings.unsupported_tm: 2D TM components (Ez, Hx, Hy) arrive in <v>{{milestone}}</v>; this build runs 2D TE only.

scriptError.script_timeout: The script did not reach run() within 60 s
scriptError.no_simulation: This script defines no etalon Simulation

idle.title: This simulation is not running
idle.body: Start it here or from Setup. Progress, the field energy and the live field appear as the solver steps.

confirm.body: Cancel this run? It has been running for {{time}}; the data recorded so far is kept.

run.lost: Lost the connection to the run. It keeps going on the server.

energy.title: Field energy
energy.label: Field energy against time step, relative to its peak, on a log scale

live.title: Live <v>{{component}}</v>
live.label: Live {{component}} field of the running simulation
live.off: The live field is off for this run.

done.cancelled: The run was cancelled. The data recorded up to that point is kept.

suggestion.out_of_memory: Out of memory: use a coarser grid or single precision.
suggestion.nan: The fields became NaN: lower the Courant factor, or move a source away from a structure edge.
suggestion.unsupported: This build cannot run this simulation yet; Setup says which milestone adds it.

results.stale: These results are from an earlier version of this script.
results.partial: This run was cancelled: the fields hold only the steps it completed.

none.title: No results yet
none.body: Run this simulation to see its fields and spectra here.

tabs.label: Result views
tabs.sparamsHint: S-parameters arrive with the mode solver and port monitors (M1–M2).

fields.noneHint: This result has no plane or line monitor. Add a DFTMonitor with a size to record a field.
fields.label: {{component}} on monitor {{monitor}}
fields.hint: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset; point for the value.

spectra.noneHint: This result has no point monitor. A DFTMonitor with size (0, 0, 0) records a spectrum.

kitchen.title: Kitchen sink
kitchen.body: Every component in its states. The field, chart and geometry here are analytic test patterns, not solver results.
kitchen.numberInvalid: Enter a length, such as 1.55 µm or 1550 nm.
kitchen.emptyBody: An empty state explains what is missing and what to do.
kitchen.fieldLabel: Test pattern: the shape of a 2D cylindrical wave
